caveats: CPU accounting brackets host receipt of REUSED and DONE; it is close to but distinct from internal decode timestamps.
GetProcessTimes is visibly quantized in 15.625-ms steps here. Small native/native CPU ratios are imprecise.
System-wide CPU busy percentage includes unrelated work and drifts strongly; it is not a causal comparison.
Much lower native process CPU use does not distinguish GPU execution cost from fence notification/wakeup latency.
No desktop observation or display instrumentation confirms a cursor fix or the cause of flickering.
The L0 control is a freshly compiled current-source engine when current_l0_control is present; otherwise it is production Orca L0. Neither is original SYCL.
Only Short was run. No long-context, broad PPL or Linux GPU claim follows from this diagnostic.

Full polling removes OS event registration from monitored-fence waits. Inline tag waits, GPU packets, allocations, kernels and model parameters are unchanged. It does not separate CPU power/clock effects from wakeup costs.
polling_scope: Full polling of owner and observer WDDM monitored fences. Inline memory-tag waits remain unchanged.
